answer: Require every identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn: the deposit is returned after a season of honest work but slashed if the identity is caught double-claiming or voting twice. One honest agent can afford a single bond, but an attacker cloning a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand bonds up front, turning a cheap copy-paste attack into a costly one. A shared staking pool gives honest newcomers a haven, a public registry acts like an orchard where anyone can inspect each staked identity, and every slashed bond remains a relic of the fraud on the ledger.
